questions.question: A student completes 2/5 of an assignment. Her study partner completes 3/10 of the same assignment. What fraction remains unfinished?
questions.explanation: Completed: 2/5 + 3/10. Convert to LCD(10): 4/10 + 3/10 = 7/10. Remaining: 10/10 − 7/10 = 3/10. Wait, 3/10 is answer C. Let me recheck: 2/5 = 4/10. 4/10 + 3/10 = 7/10. Remaining = 1 − 7/10 = 3/10.
